asked.value: The company answers as a manufacturer: under Article 18 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which applies from 20 January 2027, a person carrying out a substantial modification is subject to the manufacturer's obligations and must ensure and declare conformity on its sole responsibility, where the modification affects the safety of the machinery or related product forming part of an assembly (the source condition is truncated).

reworded.value: As a manufacturer, under Article 18 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, because it carries out a substantial modification (subject to the condition in fact 3 that the modification affects the safety of only machinery or a related product forming part of an assembly).
